Own constructor instantiates eight parent-bound parts, MAX_HEALTH attribute200, native initial HOVERING manager and DATA_PHASE initialization; phase enum maps11 actual classes, manager lazily caches instances, ends prior phase, server-writes phase ID then begins new phase.
Part.hurt first consults own isInvulnerableTo, then passes actual part to parent. Server root.hurt passes body; root client returns false. Parent multipart overload has no own explicit side gate; do not assert every part call independently server-gated.
Whole parent admission: current DYING rejects before onHurt; current phase onHurt runs before non-head amount/4+min(amount,1); resulting amount<.01 rejects; otherwise only Player owner or ALWAYS_HURTS_ENDER_DRAGONS tag calls reallyHurt. AbstractDragonSittingPhase onHurt lights direct AbstractArrow for1second then returns0. Other sources inherit unchanged amount. For eligible source capture f=current HP then invoke reallyHurt->LivingEntity.hurt; wrapper ignores bool. Afterward current phase is queried again, so no claim of a captured immutable phase across parent hooks. If HP<=0 and then-current phase not sitting, setHealth1 and switch DYING.
